title: Drendy's mod
description: This is my first mod, it simply add custom biomes with custom mobs ores and dimension
body:
# Drendy's Mod

Drendy's Mod is a simple End-themed mod which adds:

* A custom **Overworld biome**
* 2 custom entities
* Custom ores
* Custom tools and items
* A custom GUI
* Custom crops
* A custom dimension
* Custom blocks and much more

### Biome

This mod adds an End-themed biome to your world. You can find it in the Overworld. There you can discover custom entities, blocks, ores, and features, along with a new purple wood type.

### Ores

This mod adds 2 custom ores:

* Ruby Ore
* Enderite Ore

Both can be used to craft powerful tools and a custom Enderite armor set.

There are also many custom recipes using these ores, including decorative blocks and special items.

### GUI

Using the ores you find in your world, you can craft the Gem Polisher, a special block with custom recipes and functionality.

### Crops

This mod also adds Corn and Strawberries, which can be obtained by trading with Villagers or the Wandering Trader.

### Dimension

This mod also adds a custom dimension. You can access it by crafting a special block called the Mod Portal Block.

There you will find custom biomes and a new type of world generation.

### Blocks, Items and Much More

This mod adds custom building and functional blocks, as well as special items with unique abilities.

### Mobs

The mod also adds 2 custom mobs which can be found in different biomes throughout the Overworld and in the custom dimension.

If you kill them while they are on fire, they will drop special loot.

## Creator

### This is my first Minecraft mod, Hope you enjoy it!

### YouTube

If you would like to follow the development of my projects and future updates, you can visit my YouTube channel:

https://www.youtube.com/@Drendys
